OP Recruiting Direct Hire Lead

WHO IS OP RECRUITING?

We’re a recruiting services firm based in Chicago, IL that provides creative solutions to companies that need to find, attract, hire, and retain talented people. For close to three decades we have recruited for some of the most progressive technology environments in fintech, and now across AI and where the two meet.

THE OPPORTUNITY:
OP Recruiting is looking for an experienced direct-hire leader who has spent their career in agency recruiting and has a proven track record as a top producer.. This is a hands-on, player-coach role for someone who loves recruiting, understands highly technical talent markets, and knows how to build trusted, long-term client relationships.
You will step into an established book of innovative and technically demanding clients that hold a high bar for talent and are among our strongest fee producers. Your primary focus will be delivering on difficult searches, managing and growing client relationships, and helping us scale the direct-hire business. Business development will be part of the role, but much of that growth will come through excellent delivery, expanding existing relationships, referrals, and partnership with our leadership team.

  • Own and deliver senior and highly technical direct-hire searches for some of our most demanding clients
  • Develop deep client relationships, becoming a trusted recruiting partner and expanding those relationships through strong delivery
  • Stay hands-on in recruiting, building relationships with elite technologists and knowing how to approach them, earn their attention, and engage them in opportunities.
  • Identify opportunities to grow existing accounts and develop new client relationships
  • Recruit directly while providing direction and coaching to recruiters supporting your searches
  • Partner with private equity firms on leadership hires at the fund and across portfolio companies
  • Hold credible, current conversations across AI engineering, HPC,
  • financial modeling, quant development, HFT and low-latency systems, DevOps, data engineering, and how firms are putting AI into production
  • Help establish best practices and scale the OP Recruiting direct-hire business over time

YOUR CREDS:

  • 10+ years of recruiting experience, primarily within an agency environment
  • A proven track record as a top producer, including multiple years billing $750K+
  • Experience placing technology talent across areas such as quantitative development, machine learning, AI, infrastructure, data engineering, and other high-growth technology disciplines

  • A player-coach mentality and the ability to help other recruiters succeed while remaining a high-performing individual contributor

Within 1 month, you’ll:

  • Get fully integrated into our systems, tools, processes, and approach to search

  • Begin working directly with current clients and candidates
  • Partner with the team to understand where you can make the greatest immediate impact

Within 3 months, you’ll:

  • Take ownership of searches and key client relationships
  • Be actively delivering against some of our most challenging technical searches
  • Build relationships across our existing network of clients, candidates, and industry contacts
  • Identify opportunities to deepen existing accounts and generate new business through strong delivery and relationships

Within 6 months, you’ll:

  • Operate autonomously across recruiting, search execution, and client management
  • Be a trusted partner to key clients and a go-to resource for complex technical searches
  • Consistently leverage and expand our network to create new opportunities
  • Help coach and direct recruiters supporting your searches
  • Play an active role in shaping how we grow and scale the OP Recruiting direct-hire business

Competitive base salary + commission!
A company dedicated to a “Do What’s Right” mentality!
An opportunity to grow in your career with future management or leadership roles
We foster an environment of flexibility and work-life balance!
Medical, dental, vision, 401(k) matching, PTO, onsite gym and more!
Our rockstar employees have significant tenure within the staffing industry!
We have an established client base with more jobs than we can fill with the current team!
